Hello!

I am also planning to do apply an MSc but for Cyber Security. I am currently starting my pre-proposal thesis as well, I am planning to do research in post-quantum cryptography. Question: why the MSc in Computer Science and not in Cyber Security?

Also, feel free to DM me if you want to talk about some things, bounce some idea back and fourth
